{{Nihongo|'''Pairin'''|{{Ruby|白鈴|パイリン}}}}, also known as '''Pai Ling''', is a secondary character in {{TAD}}. She is the eldest of the [[Verdigris House#Three_Princesses|Three Princesses]] of the [[Verdigris House]] and one of [[Maomao]]'s "older sisters".

== Appearance ==
[[File:Pairin Anime Design Season 3.png|thumb|240px|left|Pairin's anime design]] 
Pairin is described as a good-looking woman standing tall in height. Among the bodacious courtesans at the Verdigris House, she has the largest breast size due to her [[Wikipedia:Galactorrhea|galactorrhea]]. She has fair skin, almond shaped brown eyes and dark purple hair. Her hair falls to her waist and is otherwise sectioned - some being held back while the rest falls loose, and that her bangs are parted in the center to reveal a red Huadian that is in the shape of a flower, followed by two cheek length strands framing both sides of her face.

For clothing, Pairin wears a cream colored hanfu that is usually accompanied with a pink faux furred shawl, a purple belt, and a cerise tube top underneath. As for accessories, she opts to wear blue dangle earrings and a silver flower on the right side of her head.
{{Clear|left}}

== Personality ==
Pairin is described as a rather observant and thoughtful woman, which goes well with her line of work. Like the other princesses, she became more miserly with age, resembling the [[Madam]] in that aspect. But unlike many courtesans, she sells her own body not just for money, but also for pleasure. As Maomao puts it, Pairin is a sex demoness who will go after not just customers and manservants, but also her fellow courtesans and even some of the apprentices when she feels too pent up.<ref>{{LN ref|volume=2|chapter=17}}</ref> She does have preferences for muscular men with large "frogs" and even has romantic dreams for her age, wishing to be carried away from her captivity by a "charming prince". Additionally, because of her loving and nurturing attitude towards Maomao, the younger woman suspects that Pairin genuinely longs for motherhood.<ref name=":0"/>

== Abilities ==
'''Night services''': Pairin's night services are said to be unparalleled, to the point where when one has had "a taste of the fruit", they will never be able to forget it.

'''Dance''': Pairin's specialty is dancing,<ref>{{LN ref|volume=1|chapter=22}}</ref> a skill that she trained and perfected over time. She is said to be the greatest dancer in the [[Royal Capital]].<ref>{{LN ref|volume=5|chapter=6}}</ref>

== Conditions ==
[[wikipedia:Galactorrhea|'''Galactorrhea''']]: Pairin is able to lactate naturally since her teens, even though she has never been pregnant.

== Background ==
Pairin has worked in the Verdigris House for more than two decades. When Maomao was born, Pairin became her wet nurse and primary caretaker before Loumen adopted her, despite the fact that Pairin had just become a full-fledged courtesan. As a result, although Maomao calls Pairin her "older sister", Maomao believes that she is more akin to a mother figure to her.<ref name=":0"/> Over the years, Pairin educated Maomao in the arts of a courtesan and worked hard to pay off all her debts to the Verdigris House. However, Pairin continued to stay there to keep earning money and to satisfy her sexual preferences. Her lust made her the subject of rumors, one being that she is a succubus-like character, said to suck the life force of men to retain her youth.<ref name=":0">{{LN ref|volume=2|chapter=17}}</ref>

When Maomao took [[Lihaku]] to Verdigris House, Pairin serviced him, which made him fall in love with her. Around the same time, the Madam began to consider Pairin's retirement; however, Pairin herself had no intention of retiring, instead waiting to be carried away by a "charming prince", possibly meaning that the man who ever impregnated her would earn her actual love.

== Trivia ==
* Her name, "Pairin", translates to "white bell".<!--in what language?-->
* Unlike the other Princesses who are skilled in poetry, Pairin cannot write very well; her written characters often come out backward, so she always has someone check her writing or write for her.<ref>{{LN ref|volume=7|chapter=2}}</ref>
